examples.name: Markdown
examples.summary: The same content written in a docs page: `DocMarkdown` turns a `<CallToAction>` tag into a real `DocCallToAction`. Braced attribute values are JSON, so a docs author copies them from the props or a page entry and never imports the component. The text between the tags is the offer copy.
